items.title: Pakistan, Qatar, Turkiye and Indonesia sign 'Badr' defence cooperation pact
items.description: Pakistan, Qatar, Turkiye and Indonesia on Wednesday signed a multilateral pact to promote cooperation in defence production and capabilities, the Turkish defence ministry said. The Foreign Office has yet to comment on the signing of the defence pact. According to the Turkish ministry , the signing took place in Qatar, with ministers of the four countries attending the ceremony. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif, who was visible in pictures shared by the ministry, signed on behalf of Pakistan. Reuters quoted the Turkish ministry as saying that the pact, titled ‘Badr Memorandum of Understanding’, was aimed at defence cooperation and strengthening defensive capabilities. “The agreement holds substantial economic importance,” it said, adding the accord sought to foster cooperation in military production, boost military capabilities, and help collaboration in technical military training, research and development. “By leveraging the unique military production capabilities of each country, the initiative will facilitate cooperation and integration, enhance defence industrial capacities, and enable the fulfilment of the needs of allied and friendly nations,” it added. Turkish Defence Minister Yaşar Güler, Qatar’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Sheikh Saud bin Abdulrahman, and Indonesia’s Deputy Minister of Defence Yusuf Jauhari were the other signatories. Haluk Görgün, who heads Turkiye’s Secretariat of Defence Industries , was also present on the occasion. Görgün said in a statement that the accord formed the foundation of a “strategic cooperation” to develop joint production and technology. “Technology sharing, joint development and strengthening domestic production capabilities lie at the heart of sustainable defence industry. As Turkiye, we value partnerships that go beyond off-the-shelf procurement models, that foster the development of a nation’s own human capital and industrial infrastructure,” Gorgun said. “We believe that the Badr Memorandum of Understanding will contribute to transforming the complementary capabilities of Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia, and Turkiye into concrete projects,” he added. Pakistan has strong brotherly and historic ties with the three countries, with intense diplomatic engagement seen in recent months with Qatar and Turkiye particularly. Pakistan and Turkiye, along with Saudi Arabia, are members of the Makkah Defence Alliance , under which they are to treat an attack against any of them as an attack against all. Qatar had welcomed that pact as cooperation aimed at regional security and stability. Islamabad and Doha have remained engaged as mediators in the US-Iran war. Meanwhile, Pakistan and Turkiye are part of the Regional Four (R4) Group along with Saudi Arabia and Egypt, which emerged in March and has met several times since then. Earlier this week, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi met his Qatari counterpart during his visit to Doha, where the two agreed to boost bilateral cooperation in internal security. During his November 2025 visit to the Gulf state, President Asif Ali Zardari met with Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani and offered to expand bilateral cooperation in the areas of defence production. Last month, Indonesian naval chief Admiral Dr Muhammad Ali called on Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir in Rawalpindi. The two sides “reaffirmed their resolve to further strengthen cooperation, particularly in the domains of professional training, defence collaboration and joint exercises”, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said. The naval chief had also met President Asif Ali Zardari. In January, Defence Minister retired Lieutenant General Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin had called on CDF Munir, with ISPR saying he expressed Jakarta’s desire to further expand defence ties with Pakistan.

items.title: Accès aux technologies et création d’emplois : la Banque mondiale lance sa 1ʳᵉ stratégie numérique
items.description: La première stratégie numérique du Groupe de la Banque mondiale, pour élargir l’accès aux technologies et créer des emplois, a été lancée ce mardi. Elle s’articule autour de quatre priorités : la connectivité, l’accessibilité financière, les services numériques et la préparation à l’Intelligence artificielle (IA). Le Groupe de la Banque mondiale a lancé le mardi 20 octobre 2026 sa première stratégie pour le numérique, qui vise, en associant ses capacités dans les secteurs public et privé, à aider les pays en développement à étendre l’accès au numérique à un coût abordable, à améliorer les services et à créer des emplois. La stratégie s’articule autour de quatre priorités : développer la connectivité, rendre les appareils et les données plus abordables, renforcer les services et compétences numériques, et aider les pays à poser les bases nécessaires pour tirer parti de l’intelligence artificielle (IA). « Les technologies numériques peuvent aider les pays à créer des emplois et à optimiser des ressources limitées. Pour concrétiser ce potentiel, il faut une approche globale, axée non seulement sur une connectivité fiable et des appareils abordables, mais aussi sur les compétences numériques et des services utiles », souligne le président du Groupe de la Banque mondiale, Ajay Banga. Exploiter les outils technologiques et le potentiel des petites IA Cette première stratégie numérique réunit, selon M. Banga, ces éléments, en aidant les pays à construire les fondations qui leur permettront d’exploiter les outils technologiques d’aujourd’hui et le potentiel des petites IA, une IA au service des populations. Il convient de noter que ce lancement intervient alors que les pays en développement sont confrontés à deux défis simultanés : un contexte de ressources contraintes et un besoin croissant d’emplois. Au cours des dix à quinze prochaines années, 1,2 milliard de jeunes atteindront l’âge de travailler dans les pays en développement, tandis que leurs économies devraient créer quelque 420 millions d’emplois seulement. A lire aussi : Co-investissements dans les économies rurales et les systèmes alimentaires : la Banque mondiale et le FIDA changent d’échelle « Les technologies numériques peuvent soutenir la création d’emplois dans les cinq secteurs priorisés par le Groupe de la Banque mondiale : les infrastructures et l’énergie, l’agro-industrie, la santé, le tourisme et l’industrie manufacturière à valeur ajoutée. Elles peuvent aider les entreprises à toucher plus de clients, à améliorer leur productivité et à accéder à des financements, tout en réduisant le coût de la fourniture des services publics », estime la Banque mondiale. Toutefois, l’institution de Bretton Woods souligne que des obstacles considérables persistent néanmoins. En 2025, plus de 2 milliards de personnes dans le monde n’étaient pas connectées. Seules 23 % des personnes vivant dans des pays à faible revenu utilisaient internet, contre 94 % dans les pays à revenu élevé. Et, parmi les habitants des zones couvertes par un réseau, beaucoup ne peuvent pas se permettre l’achat d’un smartphone ou d’un forfait de données, ne disposent pas des compétences numériques nécessaires ou n’ont accès qu’à des services peu adaptés à leurs besoins. Mariama DIEME

items.title: 2027: Sowore’s AAC writes Tinubu, demands presidential villa for campaign council inauguration
items.description: By Emmanuel Okogba The African Action Congress (AAC) has formally requested approval from President Bola Tinubu to hold the inauguration of its Presidential Campaign Council at the Presidential Villa in Aso Rock, Abuja, and has asked for logistical support for 5,000 participants. In a letter dated 21 October 2026 and signed by National Secretary Oshiokhue Philip Ikpeminoghena, the party said it wants to stage the ceremony on 11 November 2026 “in preparation for the 2027 general elections.” The AAC also requested the provision of food, drinks and other logistical support for the 5,000 expected attendees from within Nigeria and abroad. The party said the request was made “consistent with the arrangements reportedly extended to the All Progressives Congress (APC) for a similar political engagement.” “In the spirit of multiparty democracy, political inclusiveness, and equal treatment of political parties,” the letter stated, granting the request would demonstrate the Presidency’s commitment to fairness, equal access, and the principle that public institutions must serve all Nigerians without partisan discrimination. The AAC said it looks forward to a favourable response and asked for information on the applicable procedures and conditions for approval. The letter was addressed to the President and Commander-in-Chief at the Presidential Villa, Aso Rock, Abuja. Vanguard reports that Omoyele Sowore is the AAC’s candidate for next year’s election The post 2027: Sowore’s AAC writes Tinubu, demands presidential villa for campaign council inauguration appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Migration irrégulière : 171 rescapés retrouvés à Gandiol
items.description: Une pirogue transportant 171 candidats à l’émigration irrégulière, dont des femmes et des enfants, a échoué le 20 octobre à Pilote Bar, dans la commune de Gandiol, à Saint Louis. Sept personnes ont été hospitalisées. Deux individus sont retenus dans le cadre de l’enquête, tandis que le passeur présumé et le capitaine de l’embarcation restent introuvables. Selon les informations communiquées par la Gendarmerie, l’embarcation a accosté le 20 octobre 2026, aux environs de 7 heures, au niveau du fleuve de Pilote Bar, avec l’aide de piroguiers de Guet-Ndar. Les passagers auraient quitté les côtes gambiennes dans la nuit du 15 octobre, vers 23 heures, en direction de l’Espagne. Chacun aurait déboursé entre 300 000 et 600 000 francs CFA pour ce voyage clandestin. Les mauvaises conditions météorologiques et l’état de la mer auraient contraint l’embarcation à interrompre sa traversée. Alertées, la Brigade territoriale de Saint-Louis, renforcée par l’Escadron de surveillance et d’intervention (ESI), et la Base navale Nord ont coordonné leur intervention pour porter assistance aux passagers, sécuriser les lieux et procéder à leur identification. Des femmes et des enfants parmi les rescapés Le groupe compte 60 femmes et 12 enfants. Sept personnes, parmi lesquelles six Gambiens et un Sénégalais, ont été évacuées à l’hôpital régional de Saint-Louis pour recevoir des soins. Aucune perte en vie humaine n’a été signalée. L’intervention a permis la saisie de la pirogue et de dix bidons d’essence de 20 litres. Les rescapés ont ensuite été conduits à l’unité de gendarmerie pour les besoins de leur identification. Sur le volet judiciaire, deux individus, remis à la Gendarmerie par les militaires de la Base navale Nord, sont retenus dans le cadre de l’enquête. Le passeur présumé et le capitaine de la pirogue restent, pour l’heure, introuvables. Les investigations devront notamment permettre de déterminer les circonstances exactes de cette traversée, d’identifier les éventuels organisateurs du voyage et d’établir les responsabilités, souligne les services communication de la Gendarmerie nationale.

items.title: Netanyahu’s main election rival rules out serving under him
items.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s main rival in October 27 elections, ex-army chief Gadi Eisenkot, said on Wednesday that he would refuse to serve as a minister in a new government led by the current premier. With the poll just days away, and predictions that no side will win on its own, some commentators have raised the possibility of a unity government convening Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc with centrist and centre-right parties. But speaking to radio station 103 FM on Wednesday, Eisenkot said he was committed, “categorically, to not serving under Netanyahu’s leadership, even within the framework of a rotation” deal in which the two shared power. Eisenkot has campaigned on attacking the fitness to serve of Netanyahu, especially over his failure to prevent the October 7, 2023 attack by Hamas. Polls show Netanyahu’s right-wing coalition and the opposition camp rallying around Eisenkot are neck and neck, with each projected to win around 50 to 52 seats — just shy of a majority in the 120-member Knesset. In his interview, Eisenkot did not rule out the possibility of a unity government altogether. Former prime minister Naftali Bennet, whose party is polling third, said a government that included the current prime minister would not be an issue for him. It would, however, run counter to Israeli law, which forbids anyone facing charges from serving as a minister — although the bar does not apply for prime minister. Netanyahu is currently on trial and faces several charges of corruption, which he denies. An October 16 poll found that 55 percent of respondents would prefer a unity government over new elections should the upcoming vote fail to produce a clear winner. In 2020, Netanyahu and centrist Benny Gantz set aside their mutual antipathy to strike a power-sharing deal in which they would rotate the prime ministership between them. The agreement followed a period that saw three elections in less than a year, and the resulting government lasted only 13 months. The post Netanyahu’s main election rival rules out serving under him appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: France : les émeutes pourraient coûter jusqu’à 1,2 milliard d’euros aux assureurs
items.description: Apres les manifestations contre la vie chere et le manque de moyens dans l'enseignement, les violences ont gagne plusieurs villes. a Marseille, des boutiques Louis Vuitton et Hermes ont ete pillees ; a Lille, un Apple Store a ete attaque. Une vingtaine de magasins Sephora et plusieurs points de vente JD Sports ont aussi ete pris pour cible. a Paris, les policiers ont recule devant la foule, raconte au Financial Times un employe de Dior. Son magasin a ete epargne grâce aux rideaux metalliques baisses des 16 heures. Le quotidien rapporte que les preparatifs habituels entre syndicats et police n'ont pas fonctionne. L'employe s'etonne que les autorites aient ete prises de court alors que les reseaux sociaux annoncaient deja des violences. Jusqu'a 1,2 milliard d'euros pour les assureurs Le ministre du Commerce Serge Papin avance un premier bilan d'au moins 3 000 entreprises touchees. Morningstar DBRS estime les pertes assurees entre 1 et 1,2 milliard d'euros, contre 730 millions d'euros lors des emeutes de 2023, rappelle le quotidien britannique. Pres de la gare du Nord, un commercant raconte qu'une centaine de jeunes ont tente de forcer sa porte. Il a appele la police, sans obtenir d'intervention. Reste seul 15 minutes derriere sa vitrine, il evalue les reparations entre 7 000 et 10 000 euros. « Derriere chaque vitrine detruite, il y a un entrepreneur, des salaries, des familles et souvent des annees de travail », a rappele, dans un communique du 18 octobre, le president de la Confederation des commercants de France Pierre Bosche. Les marchandises volees reapparaissent en ligne Lundi 19 octobre, les ministres Serge Papin et Anne Le Henanff ont reuni Vinted, Amazon, eBay et d'autres plateformes pour faire supprimer les annonces suspectes. Certaines marchandises volees etaient deja proposees a la revente. « Vous vous rendez compte, il y a certains commercants qui voient leurs produits sur ces plateformes », a explique le ministre du Commerce le lendemain sur Sud Radio. Les plateformes doivent surveiller les lots de produits neufs vendus a bas prix, identifier les vendeurs suspects et transmettre leurs signalements aux enqueteurs. Un premier bilan est attendu sous 48 heures. Le gouvernement annonce aussi des prets a taux zero jusqu'a 50 000 euros pour les commerces touches.

items.title: Burkina Faso : une réforme du Code pénal réintroduit la peine de mort
items.description: L'Assemblee legislative du peuple (ALP) du Burkina Faso a adopte a l'unanimite, le 20 octobre, un projet de loi portant revision du Code penal, presente et defendu par le ministre de la Justice et des Droits humains, Me Edasso Rodrigue Bayala. Principale mesure de cette reforme, la reintroduction de la peine capitale pour les actes de terrorisme, l'espionnage, la trahison, le parricide ainsi que l'importation de produits perimes ou prohibes ayant entraîne la mort. Selon le ministre, cette revision vise a adapter la legislation penale aux enjeux de protection de l'ordre public, de lutte contre la criminalite economique et financiere, de preservation de l'environnement et de la famille, ainsi que de renforcement de la securite routiere. « Nous avons constate sur le terrain que ces terroristes recrutent en promettant aux candidats que, meme s'ils venaient a etre arretes en tant qu'auteurs ou complices d'actes de terrorisme, ils ne risquaient pas grand-chose de plus que la prison a vie », a explique Me Edasso Rodrigue Bayala. Le ministre a precise que les actes lies au terrorisme, commis « en tant qu'auteur ou complice », seraient passibles de la peine capitale. Il en irait de meme pour les auteurs et complices de l'importation frauduleuse de produits perimes ou prohibes ayant entraîne la mort. Des sanctions plus severes contre la criminalite economique et les infractions routieres La reforme du Code penal prevoit un durcissement des sanctions contre les crimes economiques et financiers. Les detournements de fonds depassant un certain montant pourraient desormais etre punis de la reclusion criminelle a perpetuite, assortie d'une amende equivalant au triple des sommes detournees. Face a l'insecurite routiere, presentee comme l'une des principales causes de mortalite au Burkina Faso, le nouveau texte introduit des peines d'emprisonnement pour certains comportements jusqu'alors non sanctionnes penalement. Il aggrave egalement les sanctions applicables a plusieurs infractions, dont certaines passent de la categorie des contraventions a celle des delits. Le Code penal prevoit par ailleurs des sanctions pour l'homosexualite et les pratiques assimilees. De lourdes amendes sont egalement prevues pour les atteintes aux normes de protection de l'environnement, ainsi que pour l'abattage ou l'exportation illegale de betes de somme, notamment les ânes et les chevaux. De nouvelles infractions ont egalement ete introduites dans le domaine des technologies de l'information et de la communication. Le Burkina Faso avait aboli la peine de mort en 2018, tandis que la derniere execution dans le pays remonte a 1988. Le gouvernement burkinabe avait annonce, des le 4 decembre 2025, son intention de reintroduire la peine capitale pour certains crimes de droit commun.

items.title: Kloto : l’UE et le Luxembourg aux côtés du Togo pour la construction du siège de l’ONAP
items.description: Kpalimé, 21 oct. (ATOP) – Une délégation luxembourgeoise, accompagnée de représentants de l’Union européenne (UE), a échangé, le mardi 20 octobre à Kpalimé, avec le maire de Kloto 1, Apelete Kossi Atigaku, sur la construction du siège de l’Office national des aires protégées (ONAP) à Kpalimé. Cette rencontre a été suivie d’une visite de terrain, notamment sur le site destiné à accueillir le futur siège de l’ONAP. D’une superficie d’environ 1,5 hectare, cette parcelle située à l’entrée de Kpalimé, en face du monument aux morts, a été mise à disposition par la mairie de Kloto 1. La visite vise à permettre aux partenaires de mieux apprécier le site retenu pour abriter la direction nationale de l’ONAP, dans le cadre de l’appui apporté au ministère chargé de l’Environnement pour l’opérationnalisation de cet office. Cette visite s’inscrit dans le cadre du renforcement de la coopération entre le Togo, l’Union européenne et le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg en faveur de la préservation de la biodiversité et du développement inclusif. Mise en terre d’un palmier royal Selon la délégation luxembourgeoise conduite par le directeur de la coopération multilatérale du gouvernement du Grand-duché de Luxembourg, Thomas Barbancey, leur pays, le Luxembourg entend accompagner l’ONAP dans l’élaboration de sa stratégie nationale, la construction de ses sièges régionaux et la mise en place des bureaux dénommés « bases-vie » dans les parcs, afin de renforcer les moyens d’action des agents chargés de leur protection contre le braconnage. Outre ce projet, les échanges avec la municipalité ont porté sur plusieurs initiatives d’aménagement, notamment la réhabilitation de la place ’’Convention des maires pour l’Afrique subsaharienne (CoMSSA)’’, la transformation de l’ancienne gare ferroviaire en ’’centre culturel et espace de loisirs’’, ainsi que le plan d’aménagement urbain de Kpalimé et de ses flancs de montagne et berges. Le Programme d’Appui à la lutte contre le changement climatique (PALCC+) /INCLURE (Initiative pour la croissance locale, l’utilisation responsable des ressources et l’équilibre des écosystèmes protégés), cofinancé par l’Union européenne et le Luxembourg était aussi au menu des échanges. Cette initiative vise à soutenir les populations vivant autour des aires protégées, à développer les activités économiques locales et à favoriser une cohabitation durable entre les communautés et la nature. La délégation a également marqué son passage par la mise en terre d’un palmier royal dans un espace réservé entre la mairie et les bureaux de la préfecture de Kloto. ATOP/ER/AYH/HKM

items.title: Delta youths seize Macaraba oil field over alleged marginalization
items.description: By Jimitota Onoyume Hundreds of youths from Ifie-Kporo community in Warri South local government area of Delta state yesterday (today Wednesday) shut down operations at the Macaraba oil field, accusing the operating firm of marginalising the community and refusing to recognise it as a host community. The protesters, who arrived at the field in speedboats, demanded justice, youth employment, and recognition of the community’s rights over Wells 24 and 25. They carried placards with several inscriptions which included , “We Want Justice,” “Employ Our Youths,” and “Give Us Our Rights or Leave Our Land.” The youths accused the oil firm of operating on their ancestral land without adequately recognising or engaging the community, vowing to remain at the field until their grievances are addressed. Speaking during the protest, one of the youths, who gave his name as Tosan, said the company had been unfair to the community and warned that the occupation would continue until their demands were met. The protesters insisted that Wells 24 and 25 sit on Ifie-Kporo ancestral land and urged the firm to respect their rights as a host community in line with the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA). They called on the company to follow the precedent set by Gulf, which they said had recognised and engaged with the community as host to its oil facilities. The youths warned that continued neglect of their demands could threaten peace in the area, and urged the firm to resolve the dispute through dialogue rather than allow the situation to escalate. The post Delta youths seize Macaraba oil field over alleged marginalization appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: YEA plans four new employment programmes for 2027 – Basintale
items.description: The Youth Employment Agency (YEA) is planning four new employment programmes for 2027 as it seeks to expand opportunities for young Ghanaians in domestic services, delivery, corporate services and agriculture. Chief Executive Officer Malik Basintale outlined the proposed interventions when he addressed the Government Accountability Series at Jubilee House today, Wednesday, October 21. The programmes are the Domestic Services Employment Programme, Youth in Delivery Services Programme, Youth in Corporate Services Programme, and Youth in Agriculture and Farming Support Services Programme. Under the domestic services initiative, the Agency intends to recruit and train young people in housekeeping, home management, caregiving and other household support services. Mr Basintale said the programme would seek to professionalise domestic work and promote employment arrangements that comply with existing labour regulations. The delivery services programme is expected to create opportunities in logistics and distribution, particularly in areas where organised delivery services remain limited. According to the YEA’s findings, 10 of Ghana’s 16 regions do not have established delivery services of the kind envisaged under the proposed intervention. The corporate services programme will cater for both graduates and non-graduates seeking workplace experience and opportunities in professional and support-service roles. The agriculture initiative, meanwhile, is expected to create opportunities in commercial crop production, farm operations, mechanisation, irrigation support and post-harvest handling. “Our vision is to build a more responsive, inclusive and results-oriented Agency that does not merely respond to unemployment but anticipates emerging employment opportunities and deliberately positions Ghanaian youth to take advantage of them,” Mr Basintale said. He said the planned interventions were intended to broaden employment pathways and support young people to develop practical skills, participate in enterprises and access income-generating opportunities.

items.title: Performance de navigation web mobile | La Tunisie en tête des pays à PIB par habitant comparable
items.description: Selon les données nPerf , la Tunisie se classe 1 ère sur la performance de navigation web mobile entre juillet et septembre 2026, parmi les 5 premiers pays dont le PIB par habitant est compris entre 3 800 et 6 500 dollars. Avec un indice de 62,15 %, elle affiche la meilleure fluidité pour consulter les sites les plus visités du pays, devant le Maroc (60,76 %) et l'Indonésie (54,4 %). Cet indice mesure la rapidité et la stabilité de l’affichage des pages des 5 sites les plus consultés dans le pays. Les performances varient significativement : la Tunisie devance l’Indonésie de près de 8 points, et l’Ukraine (51,84 %) de plus de 10 points. Ces différences se traduisent par des temps de chargement plus ou moins longs pour les utilisateurs, influençant directement leur expérience de navigation. nPerf est une plateforme indépendante de mesure des performances Internet, basée sur l’expérience réelle des utilisateurs. En transformant des millions de tests de connexion en analyses exploitables, nPerf aide les opérateurs à améliorer leurs réseaux et contribue à bâtir un Internet plus rapide et plus fiable pour tous. L’article Performance de navigation web mobile | La Tunisie en tête des pays à PIB par habitant comparable est apparu en premier sur Kapitalis .

items.title: December in Ghana must deliver economic benefits beyond entertainment – Tourism Minister
items.description: The Minister for Tourism, Arts and Culture, Abla Dzifa Gomashie, has called for the annual December in Ghana festivities to deliver tangible economic benefits for Ghanaians beyond entertainment. Speaking at the launch of December in Ghana 2026 on October 20, she said the celebrations must create jobs, support local businesses and provide sustainable livelihoods for people working in the tourism and creative industries. “The true value of December in Ghana must be measured not only by the excitement of the events or the number of visitors it attracts, but also by the sustainable economic opportunities it creates for Ghanaians,” she said. Madam Gomashie said the benefits should extend across the tourism and creative sectors, including content creators, booking agents, hoteliers, tour operators, food vendors, fashion designers, artisans, filmmakers, musicians and young entrepreneurs. She added that the experiences offered to visitors and residents should also strengthen Ghana’s image internationally. Local creatives urged to benefit December in Ghana has become a major tourism attraction, with concerts, festivals and other events drawing visitors from across the world. Popularly known among young people as “Detty December”, the period is associated with entertainment, travel and celebrations. However, the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Tourism Authority, Maame Efua Houadjeto, says Ghanaian creatives must secure a greater share of the opportunities generated by the festivities. She has appealed to event organisers to give local musicians and other creative professionals greater prominence in major programmes. “At the heart of this year’s message is a clear ambition to carry Ghanaian talents further into the international market. Our musicians and creatives deserve opportunities that match their talents. They deserve stages that build their audience, partnerships that expand their reach and recognition that translate into lasting livelihoods,” she said. Madam Houadjeto urged organisers to ensure Ghanaian performers make up a greater proportion of event line-ups. “Let Ghanaian talents form the greater share of your performing line-ups,” she appealed. Promoting Ghana to the world This year’s December in Ghana celebration is being held under the theme, “Ghana Welcomes the World Home.” The initiative forms part of the Black Star Experience, which seeks to promote Ghana’s culture, heritage, tourism and creative industries. The calls by the two officials place local participation and economic opportunities at the centre of this year’s festivities, with an emphasis on ensuring that the benefits extend beyond visitor numbers and entertainment to Ghanaian businesses, workers and creatives.

items.title: Mamprugu Traditional Council sues Jamong royals over rival chief’s enskinment in Bunkpurugu
items.description: The Overlord of the Mamprugu Traditional Area, Naa Bohagu Abdulai Mahami Sheriga, has filed an application at the High Court in Nalerigu seeking to have four people committed for contempt of court over the enskinment of a rival chief for Bunkpurugu in the North East Region. The application, filed on October 14, accuses the four respondents of defying judicial processes by proceeding with the enskinment of Melchizedek Musah Jamung as Bunkpurugu chief on September 14, 2026, despite an ongoing legal dispute over the skin. The Nayiri is asking the court to commit and punish the respondents for contempt under Order 50 of the High Court (Civil Procedure) Rules, 2004 (C.I. 47). The respondents are identified in the court documents as Melchizedek Musah Jamung, Nyani Yoagbat, Kpari Yennue and Elisha Naan. The disputed enskinment follows a February 24, 2026, judgment by the Judicial Committee of the National House of Chiefs, which recommended the removal of Alhaji Abuba Nasimong as chief of Bunkpurugu. The Nayiri contends that the judgment recognised his authority as the sole traditional authority empowered to enskin a chief for Bunkpurugu. He argues that the Bunkpurugu skin falls within the chieftaincy jurisdiction of the Mamprugu Traditional Area, over which the Nayiri exercises traditional authority. Naa Bohagu maintains that the September 14 enskinment was therefore unlawful and contrary to the customs and practices governing the installation of a Bunkpurugu Naba. Appeal pending at Supreme Court Court documents indicate that an appeal against the Judicial Committee’s decision was filed at the Supreme Court on August 26, 2026. The Nayiri further states that applications for a stay of execution of the judgment are pending before the National House of Chiefs at Manhyia in Kumasi. According to the affidavit, the respondents were aware of the pending legal proceedings but proceeded with the enskinment regardless. The Nayiri alleges that the respondents had earlier used social media to announce their intention to install a chief for Bunkpurugu despite warnings from the North East Regional Minister and the Regional Security Council to refrain from taking such action until the judicial processes were concluded. The affidavit further states that the Regional Security Council subsequently applied for an injunction to restrain the respondents from proceeding with the installation. Although the injunction was granted, it was later vacated following an application by counsel for the respondents, who reportedly raised concerns about procedural requirements and natural justice. The Nayiri argues that the vacation of the injunction did not amount to judicial approval of the enskinment. Nayiri warns of potential threat to peace In his affidavit, the Nayiri alleges that the first respondent, Melchizedek Musah Jamung, allowed himself to be installed as a rival chief, while the second respondent, identified as the acting head of the Jamong family, allegedly nominated the candidate and participated in the installation process. He further alleges that the third respondent, Kpari Yennue, permitted his residence to be used as the venue for the ceremony, while the fourth respondent, Elisha Naan, participated by placing a red hat on the head of the newly installed chief. The Nayiri maintains that the installation was carried out without lawful authority and in disregard of the February judgment of the Judicial Committee of the National House of Chiefs. He warns that the development could undermine traditional authority and the administration of justice, with the potential to trigger communal conflict and endanger innocent lives. The application is therefore seeking an order committing and punishing the respondents for contempt, arguing that such action would deter others from disregarding judicial processes. Jamong family members flee to Togo as police hunt rival chief and six others The Nayiri’s legal action comes amid an uneasy calm in Bunkpurugu and surrounding communities, with security operations intensified following clashes in August and September between members and supporters of the rival Jamong and Jafouk families. According to police in the district, the September enskinment triggered violence in Bunkpurugu, resulting in the death of a woman and injuries to four other people. Police have since been searching for the rival chief and at least six other senior members of the Jamong royal family over the disputed installation, which authorities say was followed by loss of life, destruction of property and a breach of public order. The rival chief and his alleged accomplices reportedly fled the town shortly after the enskinment and have yet to return. Meanwhile, joint police and military teams are continuing operations to contain threats and prevent further violence, including reported destruction of farms and arson allegedly involving individuals from both factions. Despite the security measures, dozens of Jamong family supporters are reportedly fleeing Bunkpurugu for communities across the border in neighbouring Togo. A woman sighted crossing the border with two of her grandchildren told this reporter that she was taking the children to Yambour, a Togolese border community near Bunkpurugu, to join relatives. “I am taking them to Yambour to join my people there. I no longer feel safe, and even the children are not safe, even in school,” she said. Another member of the community confirmed that her entire family had relocated to Nakpanduri amid fears for their safety.

items.title: PP y Vox activan un nuevo ‘impuesto al sol’ en Castilla y León que gravará a los grandes parques solares
items.description: La Junta de Castilla y León ha reformado la fiscalidad regional en el Proyecto de Ley de Medidas Tributarias, Financieras y Administrativas para 2027 y ha decidido incluir una nueva figura que recuerda al conocido como impuesto al sol . Concretamente, se trata de extender el impuesto sobre la afección medioambiental, la única figura impositiva propia vigente en la Comunidad desde la supresión del tributo sobre vertederos. La normativa amplía este gravamen —que hasta ahora recaía en exclusiva sobre centrales eólicas, embalses hidroeléctricos y líneas de alta tensión— a los grandes parques fotovoltaicos y a las redes fijas de telecomunicaciones. El Ejecutivo autonómico de PP y Vox que lidera Alfonso Fernández Mañueco justifica esta actualización sosteniendo que la trayectoria del tributo aconseja adaptarlo a la realidad actual de la región ante “actividades para las que resulta patente a la ciudadanía que están generando costes sociales y medioambientales, como son los parques fotovoltaicos”. items.title: 5 things to know about Chinese AI startup DeepSeek
items.description: The United States Department of Homeland Security ordered government agencies on Monday to stop using artificial intelligence tools from DeepSeek, citing concerns over data being transferred to China. Here are five things to know about the Chinese AI startup following the new restrictions: – ‘Sputnik moment’ – Founded by Liang Wenfeng in the eastern Chinese tech hub Hangzhou, DeepSeek started life in 2023 as a side project of Liang’s data-driven hedge fund that had access to a cache of powerful AI processors made by US chip giant Nvidia. It gained global attention in January 2025 with the release of its R1 deep-reasoning large language model, which sparked a US tech share sell-off. Industry insiders were stunned by R1’s high performance — at a level similar to ChatGPT and other leading US chatbots — and DeepSeek’s claims to have developed it at a fraction of the cost. Venture capitalist Marc Andreessen described it as a “Sputnik moment”, referencing the 1957 launch of Earth’s first artificial satellite by the Soviet Union that stunned the Western world. – Censorship concerns – Like other Chinese chatbots, DeepSeek’s AI tools eschew topics usually censored in the world’s second-largest economy, such as the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. That and data privacy concerns have led DeepSeek AI to be banned or restricted on government-issued devices in several countries, including the United States, Australia and South Korea. On Monday, the US went further by banning civilian government agencies from using products developed by DeepSeek and third-party tools created using DeepSeek. China’s foreign ministry said it opposed that move and accused the US of “overstretching” the concept of national security. DeepSeek’s low cost and ease of deployment have made it a popular choice in developing countries, analysts say. The company holds around four percent of global market share for chatbots, according to web traffic analysis company Similarweb. ChatGPT dominates at 68 percent. – Open source – DeepSeek’s systems are open-source, meaning their inner workings are public, allowing programmers to customise parts of the software to suit their needs. That is the same for other major Chinese AI players, including tech giant Alibaba, in contrast to the “closed” models sold by OpenAI and other Western rivals. The Chinese government has trumpeted its lead in open-source AI technology, which it says can accelerate innovation. “Chinese AI models are leading the way in the open-source innovation ecosystem,” National People’s Congress spokesman Lou Qinjian told policymakers in April. – Startup boost – The success of DeepSeek has galvanised China’s AI scene, despite hurdles posed by rivalry with the United States and fears of a global market bubble. Shares in two leading Chinese AI startups, Zhipu AI and MiniMax, soared on their market debuts in Hong Kong this year, and it has been a similar story for Chinese chipmakers such as MetaX. In June, investors valued DeepSeek at more than $50 billion in the company’s first funding round, according to the Wall Street Journal. Shi Yaqiong and her team at Beijing-based Jinqiu Capital told AFP there has been a “clear surge” in enthusiasm around Chinese AI — and competition among investors — since the DeepSeek shock. – Chip smuggling reports – DeepSeek’s rise has not been without controversy. Reports, including in technology outlet The Information, say DeepSeek has been skirting a US ban on the export of top-end chips to China to train its new V4 model. The Information said in December, citing six people with knowledge of the matter, that DeepSeek developed V4 using thousands of chips dismantled in third countries and smuggled to China. DeepSeek did not respond to AFP’s request for comment at the time. Nvidia did not respond to a request for comment but told The Information that they had not seen any evidence of this and that “such smuggling seems farfetched”. In April, DeepSeek said it had used both Nvidia and Huawei’s domestically-produced Ascend chips for its new model. Huawei, at the forefront of Chinese efforts to reduce reliance on US semiconductor technology, said in a statement that the full range of its Ascend products support DeepSeek’s V4 series. Washington says DeepSeek’s latest model is about eight months behind the top offerings from US companies. AFP The post 5 things to know about Chinese AI startup DeepSeek appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: YEA considering amendment of Act to become Ghana’s main employment corridor – Basintale
items.description: The Youth Employment Agency (YEA) is considering an amendment to its enabling law to position the institution as Ghana’s main corridor for employment opportunities, Chief Executive Officer Malik Basintale has announced. Speaking at the Government Accountability Series at Jubilee House today, Wednesday, October 21, 2026, Mr Basintale said the proposed legislative change was part of efforts to strengthen the Agency’s role in addressing youth unemployment and improve its capacity to connect young people to jobs. The YEA was established under the Youth Employment Agency Act, 2015 (Act 887), with a mandate to develop, coordinate, supervise and facilitate employment opportunities for Ghanaian youth. Its regulatory framework was further strengthened by the Youth Employment Agency Regulations, 2016 (L.I. 2231). Mr Basintale said the Agency was looking at how its legal framework could be amended to expand its role in the country’s employment system. He described the proposal as part of a broader commitment to make the institution more responsive to the needs and aspirations of young people. “In this regard, the YEA is considering an amendment of its Act to become Ghana’s only employment corridor into the mainstream,” he said. He stressed that the Agency’s work would continue to focus on creating opportunities and empowering young people to contribute to national development. “Our commitment is to ensure that no young Ghanaian is left behind in our collective pursuit of economic empowerment and national development, because THE YEA IS FOR ALL!” he added. The announcement comes as the Agency prepares to mark the 20th anniversary of its establishment next month. Mr Basintale said the YEA remained committed to improving its programmes and translating government policies into sustainable employment opportunities for young Ghanaians.

items.title: YEA says it receives no allocation from District Assemblies Common Fund
items.description: The Youth Employment Agency (YEA) says it continues to receive no allocation from the District Assemblies Common Fund (DACF), despite a provision in law for funding from the source. Chief Executive Officer Malik Basintale disclosed this when he addressed the Government Accountability Series at the Jubilee House today, Wednesday, October 21, describing the situation as a financial challenge affecting the Agency’s ability to expand its employment interventions. He cited Section 23(c) of the Youth Employment Agency Act, 2015 (Act 887), which provides for an allocation of 10% of the Common Fund to the Agency, subject to a formula approved by Parliament. “Unfortunately, the Agency continues to record zero allocation from this important funding source,” Mr Basintale said. He explained that the absence of funding from the DACF placed additional pressure on the Agency’s existing resources and limited its capacity to expand programmes, particularly at the district and community levels. “This situation undoubtedly places additional pressure on our already constrained resources and limits our capacity to expand employment interventions, particularly at the district and community levels,” he said. Mr Basintale appealed for renewed consideration of the statutory funding arrangement, while acknowledging competing demands on public finances and the Government’s broader commitment to fiscal discipline. He said improved access to funding would help the YEA discharge its mandate more effectively and create additional employment opportunities for young Ghanaians.

items.title: Toulouse v Troyes Ligue 1 game postponed as France gripped by unrest
items.description: The Ligue 1 match between Toulouse and Troyes this weekend has has pushed back a day at the request of local authorities struggling to contain unrest in France, the French league (LFP) announced on Wednesday. The match which had been due to take place in Toulouse in southwest France at 1715 local time (1515 GMT) on Saturday will now kick off on Sunday at the same time. “Although not considered high-risk, organising an event with such a large turnout requires the deployment of internal security forces and municipal police personnel,” the Haute-Garonne prefecture, which manages public services and security in the region, said. A second sporting event is also scheduled in Toulouse on Saturday with the city’s rugby club set to host Perpignan in a Top 14 rugby match. On Tuesday, the Ligue 2 match between Montpellier and Paris-based Red Star originally scheduled for Saturday was moved to Monday. Some of the worst urban violence to hit France in years erupted last Saturday on the fringe of nationwide protests over the rising cost of living. Since then, authorities have ordered partial curfews in parts of Paris and other cities, including Toulouse, to prevent further violence. There was tight security at the Parc des Princes in Paris on Tuesday for Paris Saint-Germain’s victory against Barcelona in the Champions League. PSG will host Lyon at the same venue in a Ligue 1 match on Sunday evening. The post Toulouse v Troyes Ligue 1 game postponed as France gripped by unrest appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: 6th iNTTA opens in Cape Coast with focus on Ghana’s 24-hour economy
items.description: The sixth edition of the Inter Tourism Expo Accra (iNTTA) has opened at the Ridge Royal Hotel in Cape Coast, bringing together investors, policymakers, entrepreneurs and tourism industry players to explore investment opportunities in Ghana and across Africa. The three-day conference, running from October 21 to 23, 2026, is being held under the theme: “6th Inter Tourism Expo (iNTTA) and the 24-Hour Africa Economy, Agribusiness, Digital Sovereignty and AfCFTA Industrial Acceleration Conference and Investment Programme.” The event seeks to promote Ghana as a round-the-clock investment destination by strengthening partnerships across tourism, agribusiness, digital infrastructure, trade and hospitality. It is being organised by iNTTA in partnership with the 24-Hour Economy Authority, Jaksally Development Organization, the Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) and International Quest for Tirth and Justice, among other organisations. The conference is expected to provide a platform for investors and businesses to explore opportunities, establish partnerships and develop initiatives to support economic growth. The opening day’s programme features discussions on cross-border payments, fintech, investment opportunities in Ghana and the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). A high-level briefing on the AfCFTA industrialisation strategy is scheduled to be delivered by Tsetetso Makong, Director of Framework and Coordinating Programme at the AfCFTA Secretariat. The session is expected to outline Ghana’s position within the continental free trade framework and highlight opportunities for Ghanaian, African and diaspora investors. Other sessions will focus on investment promotion, public-private partnerships and tourism infrastructure, with contributions expected from the Ghana Investment Promotion Authority, the Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GNCCI) and the Ghana Enterprises Agency. Dr Mary Acquaye Moore of Cape Coast Technical University is also scheduled to lead a masterclass on tourism as infrastructure investment. The opening ceremony will feature remarks from traditional authorities and public officials, including Awulae Kwasi Amakyi III, Paramount Chief of the Western Nzema Traditional State, and Osabarimba Kwesi Atta II, Omanhene of the Oguaa Traditional Area. Chief Host Maame Effua Houadjeto and Central Regional Mayor George Justice Arthur are also scheduled to address participants. Investment opportunities and business partnerships The second day, Thursday, October 22, will focus on connecting investment proposals with potential financiers and business partners. The programme includes investment pitch sessions for pre-screened companies seeking capital, alongside discussions on energy infrastructure, digital systems, hospitality real estate and agribusiness. Participants will examine modular energy solutions for tourism and hospitality businesses, as well as opportunities in fintech, digital trade facilitation and other emerging technologies. The real estate discussions will explore investment opportunities in hotels, short-term rentals, ecotourism and nature-based developments. Agribusiness and agro-processing will also feature prominently, with sessions examining commodity markets, supply chain integration and opportunities to link agriculture with tourism. Prof Gabriel Eshun is expected to lead discussions on agribusiness, agro-processing and agrotourism investment. A separate session will examine the potential for health tourism, including opportunities to position Ghana as a destination for medical and wellness services. Youth entrepreneurship and the 24-hour economy The final day, Friday, October 23, will focus on the role of the 24-hour economy in tourism development, youth entrepreneurship and business expansion. Augustus Obuadum Tanoh, Presidential Adviser to the 24-Hour Economy Authority, is scheduled to deliver a policy keynote address. The programme will also examine how small and medium-sized enterprises can support tourism growth through extended operating hours, stronger local supply chains and increased investment. A panel on youth-led entrepreneurship will explore how artificial intelligence can help transform side businesses into scalable enterprises. The session will feature Joseph Amartey, Executive Director of the Tourism Society of Ghana, and representatives from the University of Cape Coast Business School. The Innovation Zone will provide a platform for selected young entrepreneurs to present ventures spanning tourism, trade, technology, agribusiness and the creative economy to investors and industry leaders. The conference is expected to conclude with a plenary session to formalise commitments, announce partnerships and outline follow-up actions arising from the discussions. Cape Coast investment and tourism showcase Beyond the conference sessions, organisers have scheduled site visits to showcase investment opportunities in the Cape Coast area, including tourism infrastructure, cultural heritage development and coastal hospitality projects. The visits are being organised in collaboration with the Cape Coast Metropolitan Assembly and the relevant regional investment authorities. The event will culminate in a beach networking gala at Lush on the Coast in Cape Coast, bringing together delegates, sponsors, government officials and diplomatic representatives. Now in its sixth edition, iNTTA seeks to strengthen the relationship between tourism, trade and investment while promoting partnerships to support sustainable economic development in Ghana and across Africa.

items.title: ‘Where are the courts?’: Killing of Multan suspect in alleged CCD encounter sparks concern among lawyers, journalists
items.description: The death of a suspect, allegedly during an exchange of fire with Punjab’s Crime Control Department (CCD), sparked questions from lawyers and journalists on Wednesday regarding extrajudicial killings and due process. The CCD, established last year, has been criticised by human rights advocates and civil society members for a high number of casualties. The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) alleged earlier this year that the CCD has adopted a “deliberate policy of staged police encounters leading to extrajudicial killings”. In response, the department termed the claims as unfounded and contrary to the department’s operational framework. The suspect who was killed in the latest alleged encounter was accused of running over a 14-year-old boy, who worked for him, with his car in a private housing society in Multan. That incident also sparked anger among the public, with a police officer saying the teenager had been “subjected to barbarity”. The CCD claimed that the suspect, identified as Tauqeer, had escaped from its custody after it was granted the man’s three-day physical remand . According to the department, he was found dead after an exchange of fire when its personnel attempted to stop two individuals riding a motorcycle on Bahawalpur’s Northern Bypass. The alleged encounter came on the heels of another incident in Islamabad where the police claimed a suspect was killed when his accomplices opened fire on a police team transporting him. Lawyers and journalists took to X to voice their concerns over the rule of law. Advocate Nida Usman Chaudhry, founder of Women in Law, said extrajudicial killings were not the kind of justice people expected from the state, describing them as another example of the state failing its citizens. “When we demand ‘justice’, what we mean is through the rules of fair investigation, fair trial and due process,” she said. Journalist and writer Shabbir Dar said extrajudicial killings “exposed the failure of the criminal justice system that consumes billions in public funds but has lost the confidence of both the public and those in power”. Former human rights minister Shireen Mazari also weighed in on the incident, asking in a post on X: “‘Out of control’ is the new control?” A post from PML-N MPA Hina Parvez Butt, which was later deleted, prompted criticism as well. “This is [Punjab Chief Minister] Maryam Nawaz sahiba ’s government; justice is served immediately here,” wrote Butt, sharing screengrabs of a TV report regarding the Bahawalpur encounter. A screengrab of a now-deleted post made on X by PML-N MPA Hina Parvez Butt on Oct 21, 2026. Journalist Hasnaat Malik criticised Butt’s post, questioning the need to spend enormous amounts of funds on courts if justice was to be delivered in this manner. “It would have been better if punishment was given after fulfilling all legal requirements,” he said. Advocate Abdul Moiz Jaferii took aim at Butt, who heads the Punjab Women Protection Authority, for “celebrating” the suspect’s killing. “This is not justice, it is vengeance. And an admission of guilt,” the lawyer said in a post on X. Journalist Absa Komal termed “celebrating extrajudicial killings” as “legal and moral bankruptcy”. “When the police themselves become judge and executioner, it is not the rule of law, but the law of the jungle,” the former DawnNews anchor said, sharing a post about both recent incidents. Senior journalist Naimat Khan pointed out that a “lawmaker from the ruling party is celebrating an extrajudicial killing of an accused person who should have been tried in a court of law to deliver justice to the victim”. “The extrajudicial killing of even a guilty person reflects a profound mistrust in the justice system and government and undermines the rule of law,” he stressed. Journalist Maryam Nawaz Khan termed it a “total failure of the system”. “When the state relies solely on CCD or police encounters, it’s an admission that our judicial system is dead,” she contended while commenting on Butt’s post. TV anchor Nadia Mirza also questioned the characterisation of the killing as justice. “Oh!! so now you are calling an extrajudicial killing JUSTICE. Strange … where are courts?” she said in a post on X. Journalist Javeria Siddique highlighted that extrajudicial killings directly violated the rule of law, adding that a civilised society punished people through courts rather than “encounters, enforced disappearances or targeted eliminations”. Shazia Nizamani, chairperson of the Sindh Women Lawyers Alliance, called for the suspect to have been tried in court, saying Punjab police should have produced him before a judge to face trial and sentencing. “How is it possible that handcuffed suspects, surrounded by armed policemen, manage to escape in case after case?” she asked.

items.title: Yamal breaks into 10 highest paid footballers in the world [Full list]
items.description: Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal has been ranked sixth among the world’s highest-paid footballers in 2026, with estimated earnings of $55 million, according to Forbes. Cristiano Ronaldo tops the ranking with $300 million, followed by Lionel Messi with $145 million and Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé with $100 million. Forbes estimates that the 10 highest-paid footballers will earn a combined $942 million this season, with Ronaldo and Messi accounting for nearly half of the total. Below is the list of the world’s 10 highest-paid footballers in 2026, according to Forbes. 1. Cristiano Ronaldo — $300 million The Al Nassr forward leads the ranking with estimated earnings of $300 million, comprising $250 million from football and $50 million from endorsements and other business ventures. The 41-year-old Portugal captain has built a commercial portfolio that includes his CR7 brand, hotels and investments in several businesses. 2. Lionel Messi — $145 million Inter Miami forward Lionel Messi ranks second with estimated earnings of $145 million. The Argentine earns about $70 million on the pitch and $75 million from endorsements and other off-field ventures, including partnerships with major global brands. 3. Kylian Mbappé — $100 million Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé occupies third place with estimated earnings of $100 million. His income includes $70 million from football and $30 million from commercial partnerships. The France international has also expanded his business interests through a new partnership with Swiss sportswear brand On. 4. Erling Haaland — $85 million Manchester City striker Erling Haaland ranks fourth with estimated earnings of $85 million. The Norway international is projected to earn $60 million from football and $25 million from endorsements. His commercial partners include Nike and digital bank Revolut. 5. Vinicius Jr. — $76 million Real Madrid winger Vinicius Jr. ranks fifth with estimated earnings of $76 million. The Brazilian is expected to earn $48 million on the pitch and $28 million off it through endorsements and commercial partnerships with brands including Hugo Boss and Fanatics. 6. Lamine Yamal — $55 million Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal ranks sixth with estimated earnings of $55 million, comprising $35 million from football and $20 million from endorsements. The 19-year-old Spain international has attracted growing commercial attention following his performances for Barcelona and Spain. His sponsors include American Eagle, Coca-Cola and McDonald’s. American Eagle signed Yamal to a five-year deal, marking its first multi-year partnership with an athlete. 7. Sadio Mané — $54 million Al Nassr winger Sadio Mané ranks seventh with estimated earnings of $54 million. The Senegal international is projected to earn $50 million from football and $4 million from endorsements. His commercial portfolio includes a long-term partnership with sportswear brand New Balance. 8. Jude Bellingham — $45 million Real Madrid midfielder Jude Bellingham occupies eighth place with estimated earnings of $45 million. The England international is expected to earn $29 million on the pitch and $16 million from endorsements and other commercial activities. His partners include Adidas, Louis Vuitton and Skims. 9. Harry Kane — $42 million Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane ranks ninth with estimated earnings of $42 million. The England captain is projected to earn $29 million from football and $13 million off the pitch. His commercial partnerships include sportswear brand Skechers, Google Gemini and Oura Ring. 10. Mohamed Salah — $40 million Egyptian forward Mohamed Salah completes the top 10 with estimated earnings of $40 million. The former Liverpool star is projected to earn $20 million from football and another $20 million from endorsements. His commercial partners include Adidas, Pepsi and Vodafone. The ranking highlights the financial dominance of Ronaldo and Messi, while the inclusion of younger stars such as Yamal, Mbappé, Haaland and Bellingham points to the next generation of football’s biggest commercial names. items.title: Les opérateurs économiques des Savanes sensibilisés sur les modes alternatifs de règlement des différends
items.description: Dapaong, 21 oct. (ATOP) – Des opérateurs économiques et des acteurs locaux de la région des Savanes ont été renseignés sur les Modes alternatifs de règlement des différends (MARD), le mardi 20 octobre à Dapaong. La sensibilisation est initiée par la Cour d’arbitrage du Togo (CATO), institution rattachée à la Chambre de commerce et d’industrie du Togo (CCI-Togo). Elle s’intègre dans une tournée nationale de sensibilisation entreprise par la CATO du 18 au 22 octobre. L’objectif est d’échanger avec les acteurs économiques de la région sur l’importance, le fonctionnement et les avantages des mécanismes de médiation, de conciliation et d’arbitrage. Il s’agit aussi de faire connaître la Cour et de promouvoir des mécanismes rapides, confidentiels et efficaces de résolution des litiges commerciaux afin de désengorger les tribunaux traditionnels et de préserver les relations d’affaires. La séance a été marquée par un exposé sur la CATO et les MARD, faite par Mme Biré Maguila, juriste à la cour, suivi des échanges interactifs. D’après la présentation, la CATO est créée par la loi n°89-31 du 28 novembre 1989 et ses activités lancées en 2011. Elle figure aujourd’hui parmi les centres d’arbitrage les plus influents de l’espace OHADA. Depuis le début de ses activités, la Cour a enregistré 264 affaires, dont 153 en arbitrage. Mme Biré a mis en avant les atouts majeurs qui font de la CATO une solution privilégiée pour les entreprises. Il s’agit notamment de la confidentialité qui permet de préserver la réputation commerciale des parties en réglant les litiges à huis clos, la maîtrise des coûts à travers un barème financier clair et encadré par la cour, la proximité et la digitalisation des procédures, en l’occurrence la possibilité de suivre les conférences, audiences et dossiers en ligne. Le secrétaire général de la Cour, Assogbavi Komlan et le coordinateur des élus consulaires de la région des Savanes au sein de la CCI-Togo, Yébli Gobne ont rappelé que ces sessions d’information visent à accompagner les opérateurs économiques dans l’exercice de leurs activités. Ils ont invité les participants à s’approprier ces outils alternatifs de justice dans la gestion de leurs affaires. ATOP/TKA/JK/BA

items.title: Cinéma : le Festival du film chinois prévu du 23 au 24 octobre prochain à Dakar
items.description: La capitale sénégalaise abrite les 23 et 24 octobre le Festival du film chinois. Une occasion pour les deux peuples de se comprendre et de résonner ensemble à travers le grand écran, selon l’ambassadeur de la Chine au Sénégal, Li Zhigang. Les 23 et 24 octobre, l’administration nationale du cinéma de Chine et l’Ambassade de Chine au Sénégal coorganisent le Festival du film chinois au Sénégal 2026. L’annonce a été faite mercredi, par l’ambassadeur de la Chine au Sénégal, Li Zhigang. « Des aventures du désert à l’ancienne capitale Chang’an, du sauvetage héroïque avec Jackie Chan au dessin animé ‘’Les Ours boonie’’, sept films chinois de genres variés se succéderont à l’écran. Parmi eux, ‘’Lettres d’amour de ma grand-mère », tout comme le classique sénégalais ‘’Une si longue lettre ‘’, confie à la correspondance les destinées et les émotions des gens », a-t-il écrit sur son compte X. Ainsi, au-delà des passionnés de cinéma, M. Li estime que ces deux jours de festival vont permettre aux deux peuples de se comprendre et de résonner ensemble à travers le grand écran. Una mayoría del tribunal de garantías, más allá de la división de referencia entre progresistas y conservadores, ha considerado que, como el procedimiento sigue abierto en el Supremo —hasta pasado mañana, viernes, aún pueden personarse los afectados—, el recurso del Defensor es “prematuro” y que incumple el requisito de subsidiariedad del amparo: esto es, que se hayan agotado todas las vías de la justicia ordinaria. Dos magistrados progresistas emitirán un voto particular en contra de la decisión mayoritaria y en defensa de un derecho fundamental, el sufragio, que el Defensor considera restringido sin intervención del legislador ni tampoco por ningún acto atribuible a los afectados. The Governance Spokesperson appealed to party members and supporters to back his candidature as he seeks to become Deputy National Communications Officer. “I humbly ask for your support,” he added.

items.title: Jonathan urges Nigeria to shift from imports to production
items.description: By Soni Daniel ABUJA — Former President Goodluck Jonathan has called on Nigeria to develop the resources and technology needed to produce goods and services locally rather than continue to depend on imports. Jonathan made the call on Wednesday while commissioning the Zeetin Technologies plant in Idu, Abuja, which manufactures tricycles for the Nigerian market. He said Nigeria’s large youth population could serve as a major asset in boosting local production, creating economic opportunities and driving national development. The former president urged Nigeria to emulate countries that had successfully mobilised their resources and young populations to expand their manufacturing capacity and become reliable producers and exporters of goods. He stressed the need for Nigeria to harness its human and material resources to strengthen domestic production and reduce dependence on imported goods. items.title: La Tunisie prévoit d'émettre ses premiers sukuks en 2027
items.description: La Tunisie prévoit d’émettre en 2027 ses premiers sukuks (obligations islamiques), pour un montant plafonné à 9 milliards de dinars (environ 3 milliards de dollars), selon le projet de loi de finance 2027. En vertu de ce projet, le plafond maximal des garanties accordées par l’État pour la conclusion de prêts ou l’émission de sukuk (obligations islamiques) a été fixé à 9 milliards de dinars (MMDT), tandis que le plafond maximal des prêts accordés par le Trésor aux entreprises publiques a été fixé à 250 millions de dinars. Les besoins d’emprunt du gouvernement devraient atteindre, l’année prochaine, environ 28,122 MMDT (9,4 milliards de dollars), contre 27 MMDT en 2026, ce qui explique le recours du gouvernement à d’autres ressources de financement, dont les sukus, des titres de financement conformes aux principes de la finance islamique. Sur le montant de 28,122 MMDT, 13,307 milliards sont destinés au remboursement du principal de la dette publique (environ 47,3% du besoin total), dont 6,823 MMDT au titre de la dette intérieure et 6,484 MMDT au titre de la dette extérieure. Le budget de l’État pour l’année 2027 s’élève à environ 68,895 milliards de dinars, contre 63,575 milliards de dinars inscrits dans la loi de finances 2026, enregistrant une hausse de 8,37%, selon le PLF 2027. Le montant total des recettes que l’État est autorisé à recouvrer au profit du Trésor se chiffre à 54,280 MMDT, faisant ressortir un déficit budgétaire de 14,615 milliards de dinars, d’après la même source. The post La Tunisie prévoit d'émettre ses premiers sukuks en 2027 appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Toluwanisings’ family announces service of songs, seeks support for widow, children
items.description: The family of late Nigerian gospel singer Olayemi Bayonle Bolaji, popularly known as Toluwanisings, has announced a night of tributes and service of songs in his honour while appealing to the public for financial support for his wife and children. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 3pm at the Hall of Grace, Jogor Centre, Ibadan, Oyo State. The family announced the programme in a post on the singer’s social media page, inviting friends, colleagues, fans and well-wishers to celebrate his life and ministry. “We invite you to join us for a Night of Tributes and Service of Songs in honour of our beloved brother, friend, and gospel minister, Olayemi Bayonle Bolaji, fondly known as Toluwanisings,” the statement read. In a separate appeal titled “A Call for Love and Support,” the family urged Nigerians to assist the singer’s wife and children following his death on October 14. The family called on well-meaning individuals to contribute towards supporting the widow as she navigates life after the loss of her husband. “As we mourn the loss of our beloved brother, let us stand with his wife during this difficult season. Every contribution, no matter how small, is a gesture of love and compassion,” the family said. It also provided account details for donations and prayed for blessings on those willing to support the bereaved family. “Please support her through the account details provided. May God bless every giving heart and grant the family strength and comfort,” the statement added. Toluwanisings died on October 14, 2026, hours after ministering at a praise concert organised by fellow gospel singer Bidemi Olaoba in Ibadan. His death sparked widespread reactions on social media, with questions raised about access to emergency medical care after his personal assistant alleged that several hospitals refused to admit him. The planned night of tributes and service of songs will provide an opportunity for family members, friends, colleagues and fans to honour the late singer’s life and musical contributions.
